resources.string: Detects when a WhatsApp conversation is open so Screenshot Assistant can prepare and send your newest photo. It reads only screen element identifiers, button labels and the conversation title (to avoid sending to the wrong chat). It never reads message text, and works offline.
Tap Attach to open WhatsApp sharing. You choose the chat and press Send.
Tap to allow Screenshot Assistant to capture the screen once.
Android blocked opening it automatically. Tap to continue with your picture.
Send your newest picture to this chat now
WhatsApp is open but the screen was not recognised. Use Capture and confirm the recipient manually.
Capture permission was declined. Automatic capture will not ask again; press Capture screenshot to try again.
Attachment ready for review. Choose the chat in WhatsApp and press Send yourself.
Manual confirmation required. Open WhatsApp sharing and choose the intended chat.
The open conversation changed since the picture was prepared. Confirm the destination manually.
This screen is protected by the app that shows it and cannot be captured.
The screenshot could not be captured.

This license is tied to a specific phone. Open \"Phone-locked license\" below, create an activation request and send it to the seller.
This license needs a newer version of the app.
The stored activation is damaged. Enter your license code again to repair it.
The activation on this phone is no longer valid (app reinstalled, data cleared or installation copied). To recover, enter your license code again.
This phone could not create a secure key. Activation is not possible on this device.
Activation could not be saved. Check free storage space.
Photo access is needed to find your newest picture. Open the app and allow it.
Only some photos are shared with the app. Allow access to all photos so the newest one can be found.
The newest picture could not be read
Already handled for this chat. Reset its status to send again.
This picture was already handled for this chat
No newer picture than the one already handled for this chat
This chat could not be identified reliably. Manual confirmation required.
Your newest picture could not be read, so an older one was found. Check it before attaching.
Sent. WhatsApp shows a new outgoing image in this chat.
Send was tapped but could not be confirmed. Please check the chat.
Several chats match this name. Choose the chat yourself.
The chat was not found in WhatsApp\'s list. Choose it yourself.
WhatsApp showed a different recipient. Nothing was sent.
The recipient could not be verified. Nothing was sent.
WhatsApp\'s Send button was not available. Nothing was sent.
Could not open WhatsApp\'s attach menu / Gallery in this chat. Nothing was sent.
Could not find the Screenshots album in WhatsApp\'s gallery. Nothing was sent.
The app could not make sure the newest item is a photo (or it is a video). Nothing was sent. Allow video access on the Home screen.
The gallery showed no picture to select. Nothing was sent.
WhatsApp did not respond in time. Finish manually.
Sends your newest photo to the WhatsApp chat you open
Turn on the accessibility service to start
A few things are still needed.
On: notices when a WhatsApp chat is open
Off: turn on Screenshot Assistant under Accessibility > Installed apps
Only some photos shared: choose \"Allow all\"
Needed to find your newest picture
Allowed: the app can make sure it sends a photo
Lets the app make sure the newest item is a photo, not a video
Open a chat in WhatsApp and your newest photo (the first one in WhatsApp\'s gallery) is sent to it, with no tap needed. Videos and other files are never sent.
Open a chat in WhatsApp and the newest screenshot is sent to it, with no tap needed. If the newest item on your phone is a video, nothing is sent.
The app opens WhatsApp\'s share screen with your newest picture; you choose the chat and press Send.
Takes a new screenshot of the screen, then lets you attach it. Switch to \"Newest photo\" in Settings to send an existing picture.
Switch to the screen you want. Capturing in %1$d s.
Automatic sending is on: the app sends it inside the open chat. If anything does not match, it stops and nothing is sent.
Attaching opens WhatsApp\'s share screen. You choose the chat and press Send yourself.

If something does not work: reproduce it (open a chat, wait for the app to act), then copy the diagnostics and send them to the seller. They contain technical steps and screen identifiers only, never message text, names or numbers.
Expired on %1$s: enter a renewal code
Stopped by the seller: contact them
Choose what is sent and when
Choose the language of the app

Sends the newest photo on your phone: the first picture WhatsApp\'s own gallery shows. No folder is needed. Videos and other files are never sent; if the app cannot be sure the picture is a photo, nothing is sent.
Example: /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Screenshots. Only images directly inside that folder are used; nothing new is captured. Its last name is the album the app looks for in WhatsApp\'s gallery.
What happens when you open a chat
Sends your newest picture whenever you open a chat.
Sends once per chat until you reset that chat\'s status on the Home screen.
Sends only when the newest picture has not been sent to this chat yet (also reacts to a picture taken while the chat is open).
Handled chats are remembered as one-way hashes on this phone, never as names.
No tap needed: the app presses Send for you
Off: the app opens WhatsApp\'s share screen and you press Send.
Use the first picture of WhatsApp\'s gallery
Fastest. Used only when the phone confirms your newest item is the screenshot (a photo, not a video); otherwise the Screenshots album is opened.

With this on, the app works inside the chat you open: it attaches your newest picture from WhatsApp\'s own gallery and presses Send, only when the open chat was verified. If anything does not match it stops and nothing is sent. Because it drives WhatsApp\'s screens, a WhatsApp update can change how it behaves. A \"sent\" result is reported only when the chat shows a new outgoing image. You can stop at any time with the Stop button.
Only used for \"Take a new screenshot\"
Captures shortly after a conversation is detected.
Captures after the delay below once a conversation is detected.
Never captures by itself. Use the Capture button or the floating control.

Automatic uses the accessibility screenshot on Android 11+ (no repeated permission dialogs) and falls back to the screen-capture permission. On Android 14+ that permission must be granted again for every capture.
Delete the copy when the workflow ends
Pre-select the chat in WhatsApp\'s share list
Only for the manual \"you press Send\" mode. Acts only when exactly one row matches the verified chat and never presses Send. Depends on WhatsApp\'s screen layout.
This build has no license key
Received from the seller after you renewed or changed your plan
Paste the license or code you received, or import it from a file
Only if the seller asks for it. Most licenses can be activated directly with the code above.
The seller asked for an activation request
The request holds only a public key for this installation. It is not secret.

The license works offline. When you first activate it, it is bound to this installation (a key kept in Android\'s secure storage). A new phone, a reinstall or cleared app data needs the license code to be entered again. Normal app updates keep your license. Subscription licenses end on their date unless you enter a renewal code.
This subscription ended on %1$s. Ask the seller for a renewal code, then enter it below. Automation is paused until then.
The seller stopped this license. Contact them; if it is reinstated they will send you a new code to enter below.
What the app does and does not do
Your data stays on this phone
The app has no internet permission, no account, no analytics and no cloud service. Nothing is uploaded, ever.
Pictures are copied to the app\'s private temporary storage and removed when you finish, when you delete them, or after the retention time you chose.
Screen element identifiers and button labels of WhatsApp, to find the attach button, the gallery and the Send button.
The title of the open conversation, turned into a one-way hash so the app can tell chats apart. It is never stored or logged as text.
Gallery album names (for example \"Screenshots\") while it picks the picture. Message text and phone numbers are never read, stored or logged.
Other apps: only the app\'s name, to know when WhatsApp is in front.
By default the app never sends a message: it opens WhatsApp\'s share screen and you choose the chat and press Send.

Only if you turn on \"Fully automatic sending\" in Settings does it work inside the open chat and press Send itself. It sends only a photo, and stops without sending if anything does not match. You can stop it at any time with the Stop button.
Content that an app marks as protected (for example banking apps) cannot be captured, and the app does not try to bypass this.
Accessibility service: notice the open WhatsApp chat and drive WhatsApp\'s attach screens.
Photos: find your newest picture. Videos: read only the date of the newest video, to be sure the item sent is a photo. Video content is never opened.
Notifications: show that automation is active.
Screen capture (optional): an alternative way to take a new screenshot, granted by you through the system dialog.
